chapters.title: Descriptive Statistics
chapters.shortIntro: BSc CSIT sem-2: Descriptive Statistics for computer science students.

introduction.overview:
Descriptive Statistics is a vital chapter in the BSc CSIT Statistics syllabus for sem 2. The BSc CSIT program at TU is one of the most sought-after programs in Nepal for students interested in computer science and information technology.

This chapter covers fundamentals that are critical not only for university examinations but also for technical interviews, competitive programming, and advanced research in computer science.

Students should combine textbook study with practical programming exercises, online resources, and group study sessions. The BSc CSIT curriculum is rigorous, and consistent effort throughout the semester is necessary for success.

Mastering Descriptive Statistics will provide students with skills that are directly applicable in Nepal's growing IT industry and in further academic pursuits.
introduction.whyItMatters: Essential for BSc CSIT students — Descriptive Statistics is heavily weighted in semester exams and forms the basis for advanced courses.
prerequisites: Strong foundation in secondary mathematics and science

topics.name: Fundamentals of Descriptive Statistics
topics.explanation:
A thorough introduction to the concepts of Descriptive Statistics. This topic establishes the foundational knowledge required for the rest of the chapter and for advanced study in later semesters.

BSc CSIT students should particularly focus on the theoretical aspects that are frequently tested in TU examinations.
topics.examTip: TU BSc CSIT exams emphasize long-answer questions. Structure your answers clearly with definitions, explanations, and examples.

topics.name: Advanced Topics in Descriptive Statistics
topics.explanation: Deeper exploration of Descriptive Statistics covering complex concepts, optimization techniques, and advanced applications relevant to computer science.
topics.examTip: Focus on algorithm implementations and time complexity analysis — these are high-value topics in CSIT exams.
